heading_en: Calculation of the Market Risk Equivalent Amount for Default Risk of Non-Securitization Products
summary_ja: 非証券化商品のネットJTDリスク・ポジションをバケットに分類し、リスク・ウェイトとヘッジ効果の係数を用いてデフォルト・リスクに対するマーケット・リスク相当額を算出する。
summary_en: Classifies net JTD risk positions of non-securitization products into buckets and calculates the market risk equivalent amount for default risk using risk weights and a hedge benefit ratio.
paragraphs: Net JTD risk positions relating to non-securitization products shall be classified into the buckets prescribed in each of the following items according to the category of exposure set forth in that item: (i) Exposures to financial institutions prescribed in Article 30, exposures to Type I financial instruments business operators prescribed in Article 31, exposures to insurance companies prescribed in Article 31-2, exposures to corporates, etc. prescribed in Article 32, exposures to qualifying SMEs, etc. prescribed in Article 34, and other exposures similar to these: the corporate, etc. bucket; (ii) Exposures to central governments and central banks prescribed in Article 22, exposures to the Bank for International Settlements, etc. prescribed in Article 23, exposures to multilateral development banks prescribed in Article 26, exposures to Japanese government-affiliated agencies prescribed in Article 28, and other exposures similar to these: the central government, etc. bucket; (iii) Exposures to Japanese local governments prescribed in Article 24, exposures to public sector entities other than foreign central governments, etc. prescribed in Article 25, exposures to the Japan Finance Organization for Municipalities prescribed in Article 27, exposures to the three types of local public corporations prescribed in Article 29, and other exposures similar to these: the local government, etc. bucket.

The risk weight by which the net JTD risk position relating to non-securitization products is multiplied shall be as prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the credit risk category set forth in the upper column of the table. {{T:p392t0}}

In aggregating risk-weighted net JTD risk positions belonging to the same bucket relating to non-securitization products, the coefficient used to take into account the hedge benefit between long positions and short positions shall be the value obtained by the following formula. {{F:p393i0}} HBR_{b} is the hedge benefit ratio in bucket b (the same in the formula of the following paragraph); i is a product belonging to bucket b; Σ_{i∈long}netJTD_{i} is the total amount of the net JTD risk positions of products i that are long positions in bucket b (the same in the formula of the following paragraph and in the formula of Article 269-2, paragraph (3)); Σ_{i∈short}|netJTD_{i}| is the total of the absolute values of the net JTD risk positions of products i that are short positions in bucket b (the same in the formula of the following paragraph and in the formula of Article 269-2, paragraph (3)).

Risk-weighted net JTD risk positions relating to non-securitization products that belong to the same bucket shall be aggregated by the following formula. {{F:p393i1}} DRC_{b} is the market risk equivalent amount for default risk in bucket b; i is a product belonging to bucket b; RW_{i} is the risk weight provided in paragraph (2).

The market risk equivalent amount for default risk relating to non-securitization products shall be the amount obtained by simply summing the market risk equivalent amounts of the respective buckets calculated in the preceding paragraph.
